Comment: Etendo Go edge headers v2 for the content-hashed asset path: same CSP and hardening as the document policy, but no Cache-Control override. The CSP stays because a SPA fallback (custom error response) served under the asset path matches this behavior and is an HTML document; caching of real assets comes from the origin object metadata (immutable) and error responses use the error TTL, so a missing asset is never pinned (ETP-4574).
Name: etendo-go-assets-headers-v2

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; frame-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://dataplane.rum.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com {{CSP_CONNECT_ORIGINS}}; upgrade-insecure-requests; report-uri /sws/go/csp-report; report-to csp-endpoint
